title: Professional Service
content: Creating a dynamic and engaging audio-visual experience requires skilled professionals and a seamless integration process. We deliver comprehensive professional AV installation and remote IT deployment support, so your project is completed efficiently and to your exact specification.
caseStudy: A coordinated AV rollout across client locations delivered on time and on budget, with remote deployment support to keep every site online.

title: Ekahau Wi-Fi Surveys & Design
tagline: Official Certified Ekahau Partner — Precision Wi-Fi 6E/7 Site Surveys & AI Pro RF Modeling
content: Unlock enterprise-grade wireless performance with HTech Supports, an official certified partner of Ekahau. Our ECSE-certified engineers deploy Ekahau AI Pro, Sidekick 2 high-resolution spectrum analyzers, and 3D predictive simulation tools to plan, validate, and optimize Wi-Fi infrastructures across complex enterprise, warehouse, and high-density multi-tenant environments.
features: Ekahau Sidekick 2 Dual-Band & 6 GHz Spectrum Diagnostics
Interference Detection, Co-Channel Contention & Dead-Zone Elimination
caseStudy: Conducted multi-floor Ekahau Sidekick 2 surveys across 42 European distribution centres, optimizing channel overlap and boosting warehouse handheld terminal roam speeds by 400%.

title: Wireless Survey
tagline: Optimize Your Wi-Fi with Certified Ekahau Surveys
content: A proud official partner of Ekahau, a leader in Wi-Fi network optimization. Our certified experts conduct comprehensive Ekahau surveys to identify and resolve anything that is impacting your wireless network.
caseStudy: A survey pinpointed dead zones and channel interference across a busy office estate, enabling a targeted AP upgrade that lifted performance.

title: Network Support
tagline: Ensuring Network Efficiency: Your One-Stop Shop for Network Services
content: Maintaining a robust and reliable network infrastructure is essential for any business today. We support your network end-to-end — from planning and installation to migration, troubleshooting and maintenance.
caseStudy: A phased network migration across sites kept business traffic flowing with zero downtime during the cutover.

title: Structured Cabling
tagline: The Backbone of Every Successful IT Infrastructure
content: A well-designed and organized cabling system is the backbone of any successful IT infrastructure. We deliver a reliable foundation for data transmission, voice communication and security systems.
caseStudy: A full structured cabling refresh tidied and stabilized a data centre, cutting fault-finding time across the estate.

title: End User Computing Support
content: Technology is an essential tool for business success, but issues can disrupt your workflow and cost valuable time. Our comprehensive IT support ensures your systems run smoothly so you can focus on your business.
caseStudy: Deskside engineers supported a multi-site workforce through a laptop refresh, resolving tickets same-day.

title: ITAD – IT Asset Disposal
content: As your business evolves you may face the need to close a site, relocate, or dispose of outdated equipment. We manage these transitions end-to-end to ensure a smooth, secure, and compliant process.
caseStudy: A site consolidation decommissioned and securely disposed of equipment across multiple locations with full audit trails.

title: Staff Augmentation
tagline: Keeping You Connected Around the World
content: In today's global business environment, seamless technology operations across multiple locations are crucial. We provide global dispatch and on-site tech support, plus staffing solutions to keep your infrastructure running wherever you operate.
caseStudy: On-demand engineers were deployed across 30 countries for a probe rollout, covering 180+ sites without interruption.

title: Retail
content: Seamless global rollouts and wireless / data communications to support modern POS and retail network environments, from site audits to comprehensive IT health checks across EMEA retail estates.
caseStudy: A US sports manufacturer and retailer IT audit across its EMEA estate identified risks and optimised performance store-by-store.

title: Enterprise
content: Unified collaboration upgrades across multiple enterprise locations in Europe for global banking and corporate networks, delivered with backfill or fixed-term contracted engineers.
caseStudy: A global bank coordinated unified collaboration across multiple sites, including a Cisco IX5000 upgrade, with minimal disruption.

title: Data Center
content: Datacenter engineering services ranging from cable patching to full hardware deployment, racking and break/fix — we handle the complexity so you can focus on core operations.
caseStudy: Managed rack-and-stack and patching during a data centre expansion, keeping existing workloads online throughout.

title: Carrier Network
content: Specialised support for carrier-grade infrastructure, network optimisation and 24/7 engineering for mission-critical telecom operations.
caseStudy: Supported a probe rollout across 30 countries and 180+ sites with a coordinated on-site field force.

title: Manufacturing
content: Robust network infrastructure and smart-hands engineering to keep global supply chains and production facilities online — from facility audits to continuous support.
caseStudy: A wireless performance programme across production facilities improved reliability for factory-floor operations.

title: Government
content: Secure, compliant IT operations and consultative approaches, partnering directly with government entities. BPSS-cleared engineers and vetted processes as standard.
caseStudy: A Windows 10 migration was delivered for a large public-sector organisation, moving ~2,500 users across departments.
